tasks.DeterminePathDirection: Decide on the direction for the next cell based on current position and k value.
tasks.EndTraversal: Terminate traversal when all possible paths of length k have been evaluated.
tasks.EvaluatePath: Check if the path is valid and meets the criteria for minimum path length.
tasks.InitializeGridTraversal: Initialize the traversal of the grid with a starting point.
tasks.MoveToNeighborCell: Move to an adjacent cell in the chosen direction.
tasks.UpdateMinimumPath: Update the minimum path if the current path is better.
